My heart goes out to you, as I  know that loss as well.  My  mother died 52 years ago, and my father 33 years ago, and I can share that my heart still has the a deep empty space of longing to spend more time...to ask more questions,  to hold and hug them more, to tell them how much I love them.  I am thankful of all the beautiful memories, all the little sayings, all the traditions that I have asked God to fill my heart with that they so proudly passed along.  I think about the wonderful advice,  that back then seemed a bother, but has proven to be invaluable and cherised beyond words.  I guess, I never realized how much they loved me and sacrified for me, and my sibblings.  One of the most profound memories that I have is that, I never heard them complain about anything.  They accepted whatever came their way, and dealt with it with grace.  Each night before I go to sleep, I thank God, for all that I have, all that I've had, and for all that I may have one day.  Most often, my tears have become my prayers and I know that God knows what they're about.....I whisper to my beautiful mother and father, "I'm sorry, for not loving you more deeply, holding you tighter, asking you more questions about you, and your concerns....I was too busy and immature thinking about me...  The best part is I know that my parents would forgive me, they were very forgiving and understanding.  I am so thankful for their beautiful, most precious and loving hearts,  and one day we will have a huge family reunion in our Heavenly home...Oh, what a great time that will be.  So, until then, we use every moment that comes along, that brings us calm and peace...and yes, reflection to feed our soul.This is good, and I know it would bring huge smiles to their faces.   My hope is that my most precious son, whom I love with every ounce of my being and beyond, will feel the depth and scope of my forever love when he remembers me...he is indeed my greatest blessing....  Thank You God for answering my prayers.     Blessings in fathomless measure.

火山噴火の影響

大規模火山噴火は実際に気温を下げます。

理由は：

火山灰

硫黄エアロゾル


が成層圏に広がり、太陽光を反射するからです。

1991年のピナツボ火山では、世界平均気温が一時的に約0.5℃低下しました。

もし超巨大噴火が複数起これば、

数年規模の寒冷化

農業被害


は起こり得ます。

海底火山活動

プレート変動

津波による海流変化

「氷河期が早まる」可能性は？

現在の主流研究では：

地球軌道だけを見ると、将来また氷期サイクルは来る

しかし人為的CO₂増加がそれをかなり遅らせている可能性が高い


とされています。

つまり現時点では、

という科学的コンセンサスはありません。

ただし注意点

気候システムは非常に複雑なので、

太陽活動低下

大規模火山噴火連鎖

海流変化（AMOC弱化など）
